Common.name: Amazon of the Seas
Common.desc: A mermaid who serves as a herald to the Ocean Lord. She protects the sacred domain of Atlantis.

Common.name: Cursed Seal of the Forbidden Spell
Common.desc: When a Spell Card is activated: Discard 1 Spell; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, and if you do that, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards with that name for the rest of this Duel.

Common.name: D.D. Crow
Common.desc: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card to the GY, then target 1 card in your opponent's GY; banish that target.

Common.name: Double Coston
Common.desc: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK monster.

Common.name: Hammer Shot
Common.desc: Destroy 1 face-up Attack Position monster with the highest ATK. (If it is a tie, you get to choose.)

Common.name: Protector of the Sanctuary
Common.desc: Your opponent cannot draw cards except during Draw Phases.

Common.name: Rescue Cat
Common.desc: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 2 Level 3 or lower Beast monsters from your Deck, but their effects are negated, also they are destroyed during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Rescue Cat" once per turn.

Common.name: Spirit Barrier
Common.desc: While you control a monster, you take no battle damage.

Common.name: Thousand Knives
Common.desc: If you control "Dark Magician": Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

Rare.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
Rare.desc: Both players must Set Spell Cards before activating them, and cannot activate them until their next turn after Setting them.

Rare.name: Blowback Dragon
Rare.desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; toss a coin 3 times and destroy that target if at least 2 of the results are heads.

Rare.name: Dark Necrofear
Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 3 Fiend monsters from your GY. During the End Phase, if this card is in your GY because it was destroyed in your Monster Zone by an opponent's card and sent there this turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; equip this card to that target. While this card is equipped to a monster by this effect, take control of that monster.

Rare.name: Dark Ruler Ha Des
Rare.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with Fiend monsters you control.

Rare.name: Deck Devastation Virus
Rare.desc: Tribute 1 DARK monster with 2000 or more ATK; look at your opponent's hand, all monsters they control, and all cards they draw until the end of their 3rd turn after this card's activation, and destroy all those monsters with 1500 or less ATK.

Rare.name: Pulling the Rug
Rare.desc: Negate the activation and effect of an Effect Monster whose effect activated when a monster was Normal Summoned (even itself), and destroy that Effect Monster.

Ultra Rare.name: Fiend's Sanctuary
Ultra Rare.desc: Special Summon 1 "Metal Fiend Token" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). It cannot attack. Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving it. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 1000 LP or destroy this Token.

Super Rare.name: Giant Germ
Super Rare.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent, then you can Special Summon any number of "Giant Germs" from your Deck in face-up Attack Position.

Super Rare.name: Magical Merchant
Super Rare.desc: FLIP: Excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a Spell/Trap, then add that card to your hand, also send the remaining cards to the GY.

Super Rare.name: Trap Dustshoot
Super Rare.desc: Activate only if your opponent has 4 or more cards in their hand. Look at your opponent's hand, select 1 Monster Card in it, and return that card to its owner's Deck.

Super Rare.name: Wave-Motion Cannon
Super Rare.desc: During your Main Phase: You can send this face-up card to the GY; inflict 1000 damage to your opponent for each of your Standby Phases that have passed since this card was activated.
